# Artifact Gateway v0.3.0

## 简体中文

本版本让企业 SSO 用户可以先登记、后授权。管理员在认证设置中启用首次登录自动创建，并将默认角色设为 `none` 后，同事首次登录就会以“待授权”状态出现在 Gateway“用户”页面，不会获得仓库读写或管理权限。管理员可在用户页面分配、撤销全局角色；待授权用户会看到明确的等待页面。已有用户角色保持不变。

升级会执行一条 PostgreSQL 约束迁移，允许 JIT 默认角色为 `none`，无需迁移用户或制品数据。升级不会自动开启这一策略；JIT 的兼容默认仍是 reader。请先确认认证设置中的 issuer、client 和管理员 subject，再明确选择 `none`，让需要登记的同事重新登录。现有 Keycloak 和 S3 配置保持不变。

本版本提供 Linux/macOS amd64、arm64 Gateway 二进制归档、Console 静态包、OpenAPI 契约与 `SHA256SUMS`。详情见[变更记录](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)和[OIDC 开通说明](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.3.0/docs/oidc-sso.zh-CN.md)。

## English

This release adds an approval-first OIDC onboarding flow. With JIT provisioning enabled and the default role explicitly set to `none`, first sign-in registers a passwordless user and identity binding in Console Users without granting repository access. Administrators can assign and revoke global roles there; pending users see a waiting screen. Existing linked roles are preserved.

The upgrade applies one PostgreSQL constraint migration to allow `none` as a JIT default; no user or artifact data migration is needed. The upgrade does not enable this policy automatically. The compatible JIT default remains reader, so choose `none` deliberately before asking users to sign in again.

The release includes Linux/macOS amd64 and arm64 Gateway archives, a static Console bundle, OpenAPI contracts, and `SHA256SUMS`. See the [changelog](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md) and [OIDC onboarding guide](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.3.0/docs/oidc-sso.md).
